comment: Test C of docs/pedal-research/animated-covers.md: does the pedal re-read an effect's cover on each redraw? On every on/off flip the audio code inverts a striped block of literal bytes in its own cover (RLE length unchanged). Knob 1's value text reads one of those bytes back. Audio passes through.

params.name: Byte
params.comment: Value text: the first striped cover byte in hex (FE before a flip, 01 after one).
